title: Q9
description:
“These all died in faith, not having received the promises… they desire a better, that is, a heavenly country.”
Read: Gen 23:4, Gen 47:9, 1Ch 29:15
a) Abraham said, “I am a foreigner and a visitor among you.” What does that bring forward about the “better country” they sought, if they had already been promised Canaan?
